dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-on.tutorsIntro: The tutors below teach Cambridge IGCSE Accounting 0452 to Dubai students over live video, working from the syllabus in order rather than from a past-paper pile. Each profile lists the topic areas they specialise in and the year groups they currently teach.

intro.heading: The 0452 syllabus in the order it has to be learned
paragraphs: Accounting is the only IGCSE option subject where the order of learning is not negotiable. You cannot interpret a ratio you cannot calculate, you cannot calculate it from a statement you cannot prepare, and you cannot prepare a statement from ledgers that were posted in the wrong direction. Every weakness in 0452 therefore has an upstream address, and the useful first question about any student is not 'how is Accounting going' but 'at which point in the chain did it break'.

Cambridge divides the subject into seven topic areas, and they are roughly in dependency order: the fundamentals of accounting, sources and recording of data, verification of accounting records, accounting procedures, preparation of financial statements, analysis and interpretation, and accounting principles and policies. A student who is lost in area five is frequently broken in area two, and a tutor who starts by re-teaching financial statements is treating the furthest downstream symptom.

This page walks that chain. For each area it says what the syllabus actually asks for, what the question looks like when it exposes a weakness, and what a session does about it. The point is not to be encyclopaedic. It is so that a Dubai parent or student can read down the list, recognise where the trouble starts, and arrive at a first session with a diagnosis rather than a subject name.

Two structural facts shape the whole plan. First, 0452 is assessed entirely by written examination, with no coursework, so every mark is recoverable by practice and nothing is locked in by a piece of work submitted months earlier. Second, Cambridge has revised the subject: the current syllabus pairs a shorter objective-question paper with a longer structured written paper, where earlier cohorts sat two equally weighted structured papers. The version your child is entered for is on the syllabus document for their series, and the school's exams officer knows which it is.

That version question has a practical consequence. Objective questions reward recall and speed and can be practised independently against an answer key at no cost. Structured written questions reward format, sequencing and the correctly worded comment, and they cannot be usefully self-marked by a student who does not yet know the conventions. The sensible split is therefore to push objective practice into solo work and spend tutored hours on the structured paper, where format and interpretation live.

On delivery, the plain statement: IB Gram does not run in-home visits anywhere in the UAE, and home visits are a service we offer only in India. Dubai students are taught one-to-one over live video, in Gulf Standard Time, with workings on a shared screen. For this subject that is a genuine fit rather than a compromise, because the question is always which cell of which statement is wrong, and a shared cursor answers it faster than a pointing finger.

dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-on.programmesIntro: The same subject is examined differently at each stage, and that changes what a session should work on. These notes set out the Cambridge commerce pathway as Dubai schools run it.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE
programmes.description: Accounting 0452 over two years, seven topic areas, written examination only. The subject starts with the purpose of accounting records and the accounting equation, then builds through books of prime entry, ledgers and trial balances, verification, adjustments, statements for several business forms, and finally interpretation and the principles that justify a treatment.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai centres usually run 0452 in a commerce option block, and the teaching order varies between schools: some front-load double entry across the whole of Year 10, others interleave statements early. Knowing the school's order matters for sequencing a tutor's work, because supporting a topic the class has not met yet is the commonest way tutoring and school teaching pull against each other.

programmes.name: Cambridge Lower Secondary
programmes.description: No Accounting content, but the two prerequisites are visible: arithmetic reliability under time pressure, and the ability to follow a multi-step procedure without drifting. Checkpoint maths results give a usable signal on the first. The second shows up in any subject with method marks.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai students coming from Indian-curriculum schools often meet book-keeping vocabulary in a different form, so area one of 0452 feels familiar and the layout conventions do not. Addressing that in Year 9 or early Year 10 costs a session or two and removes a format problem that otherwise persists into the final series.

programmes.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level
programmes.description: Accounting 9706 extends the same seven areas and adds cost and management accounting. The conceptual jump is in interpretation and in justification: AS expects a candidate to explain why a treatment is correct by reference to a principle, which is exactly what topic area seven of 0452 was preparing them to do.
programmes.countryNote: Where a Dubai sixth form offers 9706 it normally sets a 0452 grade condition. Students who reached that grade through accurate ledgers and thin interpretation tend to find the first AS term hard, which argues for spending Year 11 time on areas six and seven rather than on more posting practice.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme
programmes.description: The Diploma has no Accounting course. Financial statements appear within Business Management, alongside an internally assessed research project on a real organisation, so the assessment style is unrecognisable to a 0452 student even though some content overlaps.
programmes.countryNote: International Baccalaureate students are about 7% of Dubai private-school enrolment and the 2026-27 intake adds three new IB schools. For a 0452 candidate choosing a route, the relevant point is that the Diploma sets no Accounting prerequisite, so the grade matters for understanding rather than for admission on that path.

dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-on.subjectsIntro: The subjects Dubai students take alongside 0452 interact with it in specific ways. These notes name the interaction rather than describing the course.

subjects.name: Accounting (0452)
subjects.description: Seven topic areas in dependency order. The marks that separate grade bands sit in incomplete records, the statements of limited companies and partnerships, and the interpretation comment. Everything upstream of those is a prerequisite rather than a destination.

subjects.name: Business Studies (0450)
subjects.description: Shares working capital, sources of finance and ratio analysis with 0452, but examines them as arguments rather than as calculations. A student who can compute a current ratio may still not be able to discuss what a low one means for a business, and 0450 pays for the second.

subjects.name: Economics (0455)
subjects.description: Overlaps on almost nothing procedural. Shares one habit of mind: following a consequence through several steps. Students strong in Economics chains of reasoning often take quickly to interpretation in Accounting, which is the one area of 0452 that is not procedural.

subjects.name: Mathematics (0580)
subjects.description: Supplies the fluency 0452 assumes: ratio, percentage, fractions and reliable addition of long columns. A student making method-correct, arithmetic-wrong errors in Accounting has a 0580 problem, and treating it as an Accounting problem is slower and dearer.

subjects.name: Additional Mathematics (0606)
subjects.description: Taken by stronger Dubai cohorts, often in a slot a second commerce subject would use. No content overlap with 0452 at all, but it competes for the same weekly practice time, which is the real constraint for most students carrying both.

subjects.name: First Language English (0500)
subjects.description: Feeds topic area six directly. Interpretation answers are short pieces of written reasoning, and the mark scheme credits particular kinds of statement. Students who write under-developed English answers write under-developed accounting comments, and the fix is the same fix.

subjects.name: English as a Second Language (0510 and 0511)
subjects.description: Many Dubai candidates sit ESL. The 0452 consequence is terminology precision: provision against reserve, drawings against expenses, discount allowed against discount received. These pairs cost marks in the structured paper independently of whether the procedure is understood.

subjects.name: Information and Communication Technology (0417)
subjects.description: A frequent commerce-block partner in Dubai. Spreadsheet work in 0417 reinforces the structure of a statement in a way students find useful, although 0452 is handwritten and the exam rewards layout conventions a spreadsheet does not enforce.

subjects.name: Geography (0460)
subjects.description: Often the competing option at Year 9. Three papers including a skills component, so the balance of practice is different across the two years. Relevant mainly to families still choosing between the two rather than to a current 0452 candidate.

subjects.name: Arabic as a Foreign Language (0544)
subjects.description: Taken by many non-Arab students in Dubai, where Arabic is a mandatory school subject regardless of curriculum. Listed because it occupies timetable and homework time that families planning a weekly Accounting practice schedule need to account for.

modes.title: Upstream repair
modes.description: For a student whose statements fall apart although the content has been taught. The sessions go backwards to areas two and three, rebuild double entry as a direction rule and re-establish control accounts and reconciliations, then test whether the downstream statement now holds. Shorter than it sounds, because the fault is usually one rule rather than a topic.

modes.description: For a student who needs the whole syllabus properly rather than a repair, usually a Year 10 student or someone who joined a Dubai school mid-course. modes.description: For a student whose procedural work is already sound and who loses marks in areas six and seven. Short sessions on ratio comments and on justifying a treatment by reference to a principle. It is the most frequently skipped block in 0452 and the one that carries furthest into AS Accounting.

sections.heading: The seven 0452 topic areas and what a session fixes in each
paragraphs: The table below is the spine of this page. It lists the Cambridge 0452 topic areas in dependency order with three pieces of information each: what the area assesses, the question type that exposes a weakness in it, and what a tutored session actually changes. It is written so that a student can read down it and stop at the first row they do not feel secure about, because that row is almost always where the work should start.

Reading it that way is important. Students routinely report their problem as the thing they were doing most recently, which in a Dubai Year 11 is usually financial statements or interpretation. Those are areas five and six, and the fault is frequently in area two or three. A session spent re-teaching statements to a student who reverses entries is building on sand, and it is the commonest way a term of Accounting tutoring produces very little.

The final column is deliberately specific about what changes. 'We will work on double entry' is not a plan. 'We will replace the memorised list of postings with a rule that identifies what each account represents, then test it on unfamiliar transactions' is a plan, and the difference shows in whether the direction errors recur a month later. Any tutor should be able to describe their intervention at that level of detail before taking money.

One caution. Topic area names, content boundaries and paper structure belong to the syllabus document for your child's series, published on cambridgeinternational.org, and Cambridge revises syllabuses on a cycle. We reference and link that document; we do not reproduce Cambridge material, past papers or mark schemes here, and a provider offering them as downloads is distributing work it does not own.

sections.heading: Double entry is a direction rule, not a list to memorise
paragraphs: Most students who lose marks across 0452 are carrying one unresolved problem from area two: they learned which side things go on as a list rather than as a rule. A list works in class, where the transaction types are familiar. It fails in an exam, where a transaction is described in unfamiliar words and the student has nothing to reason from. That is the origin of the direction error, and it is why practice volume alone does not cure it.

The rule that replaces the list is short. Every entry answers two questions: what has the business received or gained, and what has it given or owes. The account that receives is debited and the account that gives is credited, and the same logic covers expenses, income, assets and liabilities without a separate case for each. A student who can state what an account represents can place any transaction, including one phrased in language they have never seen.

A session that does this properly spends very little time on postings and most of it on unfamiliar descriptions. The tutor supplies transactions in deliberately awkward wording and the student says what each account represents before touching the ledger. It feels slower than drilling and it is the only thing that makes the direction error stop recurring, because it removes the dependence on recognising the transaction type.

The trial balance belongs to the same area and causes a specific confusion worth naming. A trial balance that balances is not evidence that the books are correct: errors of omission, commission, principle, original entry and compensating errors all leave it balanced. Students who believe a balanced trial balance means success will not look for the error the question wants them to find, and that misunderstanding costs marks in area three as well as area two.
bullets: Ask the student what an account represents before they post to it
Practise on unfamiliar wording, not on recognisable transaction types
A balanced trial balance does not prove the records are correct
Direction errors are conceptual; more drill reinforces the wrong habit

sections.heading: Verification: control accounts, reconciliation and errors
paragraphs: Area three is where Dubai students most often describe the subject as confusing, and the reason is that it asks for sequence rather than content. A control account is not difficult to understand; it is difficult to complete under time pressure because the candidate has to decide which items belong in it, on which side, and in which order, with several distractors deliberately included. The knowledge is small and the procedure is unforgiving.

The same is true of a bank reconciliation. The content is a short list of possible differences: unpresented items, unrecorded bank charges and credits, errors in the cash book. The difficulty is deciding what adjusts which side and in what order, and students who learned it as a layout to copy rather than as a comparison between two records will adapt badly to a question phrased differently.

Correction of errors and the suspense account complete the area, and they fail for a particular reason. The question usually gives an error and asks for the journal entries to correct it, which requires the student to know what the wrong entry was, what the right entry is, and therefore what the difference is. Students who try to go straight to the correction skip the first step and get the direction wrong roughly half the time, which is exactly the coin-flip pattern a marked script reveals.

A session on this area is procedural coaching, not teaching. The tutor sets the question, watches the sequence, stops at the first decision point and asks why that item is going there. Done this way a persistent control account problem usually closes in two sessions. Done by re-explaining what a control account is, it does not close at all, because the student already knew that part.

sections.heading: Accounting procedures: the adjustments that decide the statement
paragraphs: Area four is the hinge of the syllabus. Depreciation and disposals, provisions for doubtful debts, accruals and prepayments, and the treatment of capital against revenue expenditure all arrive here, and they are the adjustments a question applies to a trial balance before asking for statements. A student who cannot execute them cannot reach area five intact, however well they know the layout of an income statement.

Depreciation causes the most trouble, and specifically disposals. The calculation of a straight-line or reducing-balance charge is arithmetic most students manage. Disposal requires three or four linked entries removing cost and accumulated depreciation, bringing in proceeds and recognising a profit or loss, and the sequence has to be right. It is the single most common named target in 0452 tutoring and it responds quickly to being drilled as a sequence rather than as a concept.

Accruals and prepayments fail differently. The arithmetic is trivial and the direction is not: students know an amount must be adjusted and then guess which way. The fix is the same as in area two, which is to ask what the account represents. A prepayment is something the business has paid for and not yet used, so it is an asset, and that sentence settles the direction every time without a rule to recall.

Capital against revenue expenditure deserves a mention because it is tested in short questions and in principles. The distinction is conceptual, the examples are often deliberately borderline, and the marks are cheap to collect once a student has a working test. It is also a natural bridge into area seven, where the same decision gets justified by reference to a named principle.

sections.heading: Financial statements: four business forms, four presentations
paragraphs: Area five is where most of the structured paper's marks concentrate, and where a tutor with professional accounting experience but no Cambridge experience most reliably goes wrong. The issue is presentation. 0452 credits a specific structure for each business form, and a technically correct statement laid out the way a practising accountant would produce it will lose marks that the student has no way of anticipating.

The forms are distinct enough to need separate practice. A sole trader's statements are the base case. A partnership adds appropriation of profit, partners' current and capital accounts, interest on capital and salaries. A limited company brings in share capital, reserves and a different presentation of equity. Clubs and societies replace profit with a surplus or deficit and introduce a receipts and payments account and subscriptions, which students find alien because the vocabulary changes rather than the arithmetic.

Manufacturing accounts belong here too and are a special case. They are rarely prepared in professional practice in the form the syllabus wants, so general accounting experience is close to useless and syllabus familiarity is everything. The cost of production statement has a required order, prime cost and factory overheads must be separated, and work in progress is adjusted in a specific place. Students taught this from a textbook alone usually have it almost right, which is worse than not knowing it.

Incomplete records, finally, is the area that separates grade bands most sharply. The task is to reconstruct missing figures from fragments using margins, mark-ups and control account logic, and the danger is that a wrong reconstruction can be internally consistent and plausible. A student practising alone cannot detect this, which is the strongest single argument for marked practice in this subject and the clearest place where a specialist hour is worth its difference in price.

sections.heading: Interpretation: the ratio is the easy half
paragraphs: Area six is where students with clean procedural work still lose marks, and the reason is that they treat it as a calculation exercise. It is not. The ratio is arithmetic and almost everyone gets it. The marks are in the comment: what this figure suggests about this business, how it compares with the previous year or with another business, and what might explain the change. A calculated ratio with no comment earns the calculation mark and nothing else.

The eight ratios a 0452 candidate works with are a short list, and the pattern of credited comments is equally short. A gross margin that has fallen points to selling prices, purchase costs or inventory losses. A current ratio that is high is not automatically good, because it may mean cash sitting idle or inventory not selling. A rate of inventory turnover that has slowed suggests overstocking or weaker demand. Each of those is a sentence, and each is the thing the mark scheme is looking for.

The reason students do not write them is usually that nobody has told them what a credited comment looks like. They write 'the current ratio has decreased', which restates the calculation, or 'the business is doing badly', which is a judgement with nothing behind it. The repair is to practise the middle thing: a cause, a consequence and a comparison, in two or three sentences, against a figure they have just computed.

This area carries further than any other. Accounting 9706 at AS level is substantially about interpretation and justification, so a student who leaves 0452 with strong procedure and no comment skill arrives at sixth form missing the half that is about to be examined hardest. For a Dubai family deciding where to spend a limited number of hours in Year 11, this is the area with the best return beyond the IGCSE itself.

sections.heading: Principles and policies, and why the last area earns two hours
paragraphs: Area seven is the one students skip, partly because it arrives last and partly because it looks like definitions. It is not definitions. The question asks which principle justifies a treatment the candidate has already met: why an expense is matched to a period, why inventory is valued at the lower of cost and net realisable value, why a business's records are kept separately from its owner's affairs, why a provision for doubtful debts is created at all.

Taught as a list of names, the area produces answers that state a principle without connecting it to anything, which earns little. Taught as a second pass over areas three, four and five, it becomes cheap marks and it also strengthens the earlier areas, because a student who can say why an accrual exists stops guessing its direction. That double benefit is why two hours here is one of the better-value purchases in the syllabus.

It is also the area that explains the subject. A student who understands that accounting policies are choices made for reasons, rather than rules handed down, writes better interpretation comments in area six and copes better with the deliberately borderline capital-against-revenue questions in area four. Several things that looked arbitrary become reasoned, which tends to change how a student feels about the whole subject in their final term.

For Dubai students continuing to Accounting 9706, this is the clearest bridge in the syllabus. AS Accounting repeatedly asks for justification by reference to a principle, and a candidate who met area seven as a list of terms in the last fortnight before the IGCSE will meet it again as a demand they are not ready for.

sections.heading: How the papers are built, and how a session should be sequenced
paragraphs: Confirm the paper structure for your child's series on the syllabus document, because Cambridge has revised 0452: the current version pairs a shorter objective-question paper with a longer structured written paper, where earlier cohorts sat two equally weighted structured papers. The exams officer at the school knows which version the centre entered. Everything below assumes the structured paper carries the larger share, which is the case on the current syllabus.

The practical consequence is a split in how practice is bought. Objective questions test recall, terminology and quick calculation across the whole syllabus, and they can be practised independently against an answer key for nothing. Structured questions test sequence, presentation and the credited comment, and they are the ones a student cannot usefully self-mark. Tutored hours should go almost entirely to the second, and families frequently do the reverse because supervised objective practice is easier to organise.

A session itself should follow the same logic the syllabus does. Start from a marked piece of the student's own work, identify the furthest upstream error, work on that, then re-test the downstream task that originally failed. The order matters: fixing an upstream rule and never returning to the statement that exposed it leaves the student knowing a rule and still unable to complete the task they will be set.

Timing deserves its own session near the end. The structured paper rewards finishing, and a candidate who runs out of time loses whole final parts regardless of understanding. Two full timed papers with a per-question clock, marked, is usually enough to convert a student who knows the material into one who can deliver it in the time available, and it is the cheapest set of marks still available eight weeks out.

sections.heading: Availability, honesty boundaries and how Dubai sessions run
paragraphs: A family sends a marked 0452 paper or names the topic areas the school has raised. The trial lesson is free, collects no card details, and is spent locating the furthest upstream error on that paper. It ends with a written note naming the topic area the work should start from, the sub-skill involved, and an estimate of how many sessions it needs. If the honest estimate is two sessions in area two, that is what the note says.

Sessions then run one-to-one over live video at a fixed slot in Gulf Standard Time, with workings on a shared screen. Practice is written independently between sessions and marked with each error located, because that is the only way to tell one propagated error from several separate ones. IB Gram does not offer in-home visits in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India, and that is stated on every country page we publish.

On availability, the honest version. Accounting is sat by a smaller Dubai cohort than maths or the sciences, and the tutors who can mark incomplete records, manufacturing accounts and limited company statements against the credited presentation are a subset of that. There are weeks when none has a free evening slot in Gulf Standard Time. When that happens we say so, name the limitation on the nearest alternative, and give the likely wait rather than filling the slot and hoping.

The fixed limits: a tutor teaches, reviews and gives feedback on work the student has produced, and nobody here will produce assessed material for a student under any board. We reference Cambridge syllabus documents, past papers and mark schemes and link the official pages rather than distributing them. IB Gram holds no accreditation from KHDA, ADEK, the Ministry of Education, Cambridge or Pearson, runs no premises in the UAE, and makes no promise about a grade.

process.title: Name the topic area, not the subject
process.description: A message saying 'Year 11, Cambridge 0452, control accounts and depreciation disposals, mock attached' produces a plan in hours. 'Needs accounting help' produces a week of questions. If the school has not named areas, ask the subject teacher which ones are weak; it is a two-minute question with a specific answer.

process.title: Free trial lesson, spent finding the upstream error
process.description: One session at no cost and with no card details collected, worked through your child's own marked paper. It ends with a written note naming the furthest upstream topic area at fault, the sub-skill involved and a session estimate. Often the area named is two steps earlier than the one the family expected.

process.title: Work in dependency order
process.description: Sessions follow the syllabus chain rather than the exam timetable, because a statement built on reversed entries cannot be fixed by teaching statements. The sequence is agreed in writing, and each area is re-tested on the downstream task that originally exposed it before the plan moves on.

process.title: Practise alone, mark together
process.description: Structured questions written independently and timed between sessions, then marked with every error located so that one carried-forward mistake is not counted as six. Objective practice stays independent and unpaid, against an answer key, which is where it belongs.

process.title: Finish on timing
process.description: The last two sessions before a series go on full timed papers with a per-question clock. A candidate who knows the material and loses the final parts of a structured paper to the clock is leaving the cheapest marks on the table, and this is the one intervention that reliably recovers them.

whyPoints.title: Diagnosis before content
whyPoints.description: A weakness in financial statements usually has its cause two topic areas upstream, and we look for it there first. Re-teaching the area a student was most recently struggling with is the commonest way an Accounting term produces effort, pleasant sessions and very little movement.

whyPoints.title: Presentation taught per business form
whyPoints.description: Sole trader, partnership, limited company, club or society, manufacturing. Each has a presentation 0452 credits, and correct figures in the wrong structure lose marks. This is precisely where a tutor with professional practice but no Cambridge experience is least reliable.

whyPoints.title: Interpretation taught as writing
whyPoints.description: The ratio is the easy half. A credited comment names a cause, a consequence and a comparison, and most students have never been shown one. This is also the half of the subject that AS Accounting examines hardest, so the hours carry past the IGCSE.

whyPoints.title: Marked practice, errors located
whyPoints.description: Incomplete records cannot be self-checked: a reconstruction can be plausible and wrong from the second line. Marking that locates each error and separates propagated figures from separate mistakes is what makes practice in this subject worth anything.

whyPoints.title: Specialists reachable from anywhere in Dubai
whyPoints.description: The subset of tutors who can mark manufacturing accounts and limited company statements against the credited presentation is small. Delivering over live video means a family in Mirdif or Al Qusais chooses from the same subset as a family in Al Barsha.

whyPoints.title: Claims limited to what can be shown
whyPoints.description: Syllabus structure referenced to the Cambridge document rather than restated as fact, every AED figure attributed to the provider that published it, no regulator approval claimed, no invented statistic, and no promise about a grade in any series.

faqs.question: Which 0452 topic area should my child work on first?
faqs.answer: The furthest upstream one that is not secure, not the one they were doing most recently. The seven areas run in dependency order, so a student failing at financial statements is often reversing entries in area two or mis-sequencing a control account in area three. Working on statements in that situation builds on an unsecured foundation. One marked paper is normally enough to locate the real starting point, and it is frequently two areas earlier than the family expected.

faqs.question: Why does my child reverse debits and credits under exam pressure?
faqs.answer: Because the postings were learned as a list rather than as a rule. A list works in class, where transaction types are familiar, and fails in an exam, where a transaction is described in unfamiliar language. The repair is to teach what each account represents: the account that receives is debited, the account that gives is credited, and that single idea places any transaction. Drilling more postings reinforces the list and leaves the underlying dependence on recognition intact.

faqs.question: Does a balanced trial balance mean my child's work is correct?
faqs.answer: No, and the belief that it does costs marks. Errors of omission, commission, principle and original entry, along with compensating errors, all leave a trial balance balanced. That is exactly why the syllabus has a correction of errors topic and a suspense account. A student who treats a balanced trial balance as proof will not go looking for the error a question wants found, which turns a single misunderstanding into losses across two topic areas.

faqs.question: How does the suspense account work in 0452, and when is it needed?
faqs.answer: It is used when a trial balance does not balance, holding the difference temporarily while the errors causing it are identified and corrected by journal entry. The marks are in the method. For each error a candidate has to establish what entry was actually made, what entry should have been made, and therefore what correcting entry is required. Students who go straight to the correction skip the first step and get the direction wrong about half the time, which is visible as a coin-flip pattern on a marked script.

faqs.question: Why do depreciation disposal questions cost so many marks?
faqs.answer: Because a disposal is a sequence rather than a calculation. Cost and accumulated depreciation have to be removed, proceeds brought in, and the resulting profit or loss recognised, and the entries have to be made in the right places. The charge itself, straight line or reducing balance, is arithmetic most students manage. Disposals respond well to being drilled as a fixed sequence over two sessions, which is why they are one of the most common named targets in 0452 tutoring.

faqs.question: How do I know which way to adjust an accrual or a prepayment?
faqs.answer: Ask what the account represents rather than trying to recall a rule. A prepayment is something the business has paid for and not yet used, which makes it an asset, and that sentence settles the direction every time. An accrual is something used and not yet paid for, which makes it a liability. Students who know the arithmetic and guess the direction are relying on recognition, and the fix is conceptual rather than more practice at the same question type.

faqs.question: What changes when 0452 asks for a partnership's statements instead of a sole trader's?
faqs.answer: The profit calculation is the same; the distribution is new. A partnership adds appropriation of profit, partners' capital and current accounts, interest on capital and partners' salaries. The commonest error is placing appropriation items in the income statement, which mixes earning the profit with sharing it out. Teaching the two as separate stages, with the appropriation section built only after the profit figure is final, removes most of the loss in one session.

faqs.question: Why are manufacturing accounts in 0452 harder than they look?
faqs.answer: Because the required order is specific and professional experience does not supply it. Practising accountants rarely prepare a cost of production statement in the syllabus form, so a tutor with strong real-world background may teach a structure that is reasonable and uncredited. Prime cost and factory overheads must be separated, and work in progress adjusted in a particular place. Students taught from a textbook alone usually have it almost right, which loses marks more quietly than not knowing it at all.

faqs.question: Can my child practise incomplete records questions without a tutor?
faqs.answer: Not safely. Incomplete records asks for reconstruction of missing figures from fragments using margin, mark-up and control account logic, and a wrong reconstruction can be internally consistent and entirely plausible. A student working alone has no way to detect that the chain diverged at the second line. This is the area where grade bands separate most sharply in 0452 and the clearest place where marked practice with a specialist is worth its price difference.

faqs.question: How many marks does a ratio calculation earn without a comment?
faqs.answer: The calculation mark and no more, which is why area six disappoints students with clean procedural work. The marks sit in what the figure says about that business: a cause, a consequence and a comparison with the previous year or another firm. 'The current ratio has decreased' restates the arithmetic. 'The current ratio has fallen because inventory is not selling, so the business depends on credit to meet short-term debts' is the kind of statement a mark scheme credits.

faqs.question: Is a high current ratio in 0452 always a good sign?
faqs.answer: No, and saying so is a quick way to earn an interpretation mark. A high current ratio can mean cash sitting idle rather than being invested, or inventory that is not selling and is therefore less liquid than its value suggests. That is why the liquid or acid test ratio exists: it strips out inventory and shows whether short-term debts could be met without relying on sales. Candidates who treat high as good and low as bad lose marks they could have had with one more sentence.

faqs.question: Is topic area seven on accounting principles worth spending sessions on?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the most commonly skipped area in the syllabus. It asks which principle justifies a treatment the candidate has already met, such as why an expense is matched to a period or why inventory is valued at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Taught as a second pass over the earlier areas, it earns marks of its own and strengthens the direction decisions in area four. It is also the clearest bridge into AS Accounting.

faqs.question: Should we spend tutored hours on the objective paper or the structured paper?
faqs.answer: Almost entirely on the structured paper. Objective questions test recall, terminology and quick calculation, and a student can practise them alone against an answer key at no cost. Structured questions test sequence, presentation and the credited comment, none of which a student can self-mark while they are still learning the conventions. Families often do the opposite because supervised objective practice is easy to organise and feels productive, and it is the cheaper half of the subject to cover.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram provide an Accounting tutor who comes to our Dubai address?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer in-home visits anywhere in the UAE, and home visits are a service we run only in India. Dubai students are taught one-to-one over live video at a fixed slot in Gulf Standard Time, with workings on a shared screen. For this subject that matters practically: the question is always which cell of which statement went wrong, and a shared cursor identifies it faster and more precisely than a finger on a page viewed from the wrong angle.

faqs.question: How late is too late to start working through the 0452 syllabus properly?
faqs.answer: Eight weeks before the papers is still useful, but the plan changes shape. At that point there is no time to walk all seven areas, so the work goes to the two upstream faults doing the most damage plus two full timed papers on the clock. A candidate who knows the material and loses the final parts of the structured paper to timing is leaving the cheapest marks available, and timing is the one thing that reliably improves inside two sessions.

dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-on.closingHeading: Find the upstream fault before buying hours
dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-on.closingBody: Accounting rewards being honest about where the chain broke. A Dubai student struggling with financial statements is usually carrying an unresolved direction rule from area two or a sequencing problem from area three, and no amount of statement practice repairs that. Send a recent marked 0452 paper and the free trial lesson will locate the furthest upstream error, name the sub-skill involved and estimate the sessions it needs, at no cost and with no card details collected. The note is yours either way, including if the answer is two sessions rather than a term of weekly lessons.

intro.heading: Costing 0452 by topic area rather than by the hour
paragraphs: Accounting is the rare IGCSE subject where you can estimate the bill before you start. The syllabus is procedural, the seven topic areas are sequential, and a student either executes a double-entry chain correctly or does not. That makes diagnosis fast and the work finite: a Dubai family can usually be told, after one marked paper, that the gap is control accounts and incomplete records and that it is roughly five hours of work. Nobody can say that about an essay subject.

Hourly rates in Dubai are the wrong unit for this subject, which is why the tables below cost topic areas instead. Market bands exist and they matter: a qualified online subject tutor is quoted between AED 150 and 300 an hour, an exam-board specialist between AED 200 and 450, and in-home one-to-one between AED 180 and 500 with travel absorbed. Unitors publishes IGCSE tuition from AED 150, TutorChase quotes AED 270, Bestimate's 2026 Dubai table reaches AED 450 and above, and budget providers advertise from AED 33 to 65. Those are market figures from the providers named, not an IB Gram price list.

The useful observation is that the usual rule about cheap tutors is partly wrong for Accounting. In a discursive subject a budget tutor can teach content and cannot mark an argument, so the cheap hour is poor value. In 0452, several topic areas are purely procedural and a competent graduate can drill them perfectly well. A Dubai family on a tight budget can legitimately buy cheap hours for the first four topic areas and reserve the expensive hours for the parts where cheap help reliably fails.

Four places where it fails, specifically: financial statements for partnerships and limited companies, manufacturing accounts, incomplete records, and ratio interpretation. The first three go wrong because a tutor who has not worked through Cambridge scripts produces technically correct answers in the wrong format, and 0452 pays for format. The fourth fails because interpretation is a written skill wearing an accounting costume, and the mark scheme wants a comment about the business rather than a calculated figure.

There is also a version question that changes the plan. Cambridge revised 0452 so that the current syllabus pairs a shorter objective paper with a longer structured written paper, where earlier cohorts sat two equally weighted structured written papers. Which version your child is entered for is stated on the syllabus document for their series on cambridgeinternational.org, and it matters: objective-question practice is nearly free and can be done alone, while structured written practice needs marking, which is the part you are paying for.

On the format of delivery, the honest position. IB Gram does not run in-home visits anywhere in the UAE, and home visits are a service we offer only in India. Everything described here is one-to-one over live video. For Accounting that turns out to suit the subject unusually well, because ledger work on a shared screen is visible to both people in a way that a notebook across a table is not.

dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-tu.programmesIntro: Accounting 0452 sits in a commerce pathway with a clear before and after, and the cost of support changes at each stage. The notes below set out what each stage asks for and what it is reasonable to spend on it.

programmes.name: Cambridge IGCSE
programmes.description: Accounting 0452 runs over two years across seven topic areas, from the fundamentals and double entry through verification, accounting procedures, financial statements, analysis and interpretation, and accounting principles. Assessment is entirely by written examination with no coursework component, so the whole grade is produced under timed conditions and every mark is recoverable by practice.
programmes.countryNote: In Dubai, 0452 usually appears in a commerce option block alongside Business Studies 0450 or Economics 0455, and some centres run it only when numbers allow. Because the subject is sequential, a student who misses a term in Year 10 carries the gap forward: ledgers taught badly in October are still wrong in May, which is why early diagnosis is cheaper here than in any other option subject.

programmes.name: Cambridge Lower Secondary
programmes.description: There is no Accounting before Year 10, but the prerequisite is visible earlier and it is arithmetic discipline rather than mathematical ability. A student who makes two slips per page of calculation will make two slips per ledger, and in 0452 a single transposed figure can carry through a whole statement and cost marks at every stage it touches.
programmes.countryNote: Dubai families whose children arrive from CBSE or Indian-curriculum schools often find the numerical side of 0452 comfortable and the terminology foreign, because the vocabulary and layout conventions differ. That is a cheap gap to close, usually two sessions, and it is worth closing before Year 10 rather than discovering it in a Year 11 mock.

programmes.name: Cambridge International AS and A Level
programmes.description: Accounting 9706 continues the subject at sixth form and the step up is in volume and in interpretation rather than in new concepts. Students who reached their 0452 grade by memorising layouts without understanding why a figure sits where it does tend to struggle in the first AS term, because 9706 asks for judgement about what the statements mean.
programmes.countryNote: Where a Dubai sixth form offers Accounting 9706, it commonly sets a grade condition in 0452 for entry. If that is the plan, spending money in Year 11 on interpretation rather than on more ledger drill is the better investment, because interpretation is the half of the subject that carries forward and the layouts will be re-taught anyway.

programmes.name: IB Diploma Programme
programmes.description: There is no direct Accounting equivalent in the Diploma; the nearest is Business Management, where financial statements appear as one part of a wider course and are assessed alongside an internally assessed research project. A 0452 student moving to the Diploma will find the accounting content easy and the written demands unfamiliar.
programmes.countryNote: International Baccalaureate students make up around 7% of Dubai private-school enrolment and the emirate is adding three new IB schools in the 2026-27 intake. For families weighing the two post-16 routes, the practical point is that 0452 is not an entry requirement on the Diploma pathway, so the grade matters less for admission there than on the A Level route.

dubai/cambridge-igcse-accounting-0452-tu.subjectsIntro: Most Dubai families buying 0452 support are also paying for something else that term. The notes below cover the subjects most often bought alongside it, with the cost consequence of each pairing rather than a description of the course.

subjects.name: Accounting (0452)
subjects.description: Seven topic areas, written examination only. Costs are concentrated in financial statements, incomplete records, manufacturing accounts and ratio interpretation. The early areas are drillable at a low rate; the later ones are where a specialist earns the difference between AED 150 and AED 300 an hour.

subjects.name: Business Studies (0450)
subjects.description: The commonest pairing in Dubai commerce blocks. Shares working capital, sources of finance and ratio analysis with 0452, so one tutor across both saves real hours. Fails differently: 0450 marks go on application and judgement rather than on procedure.

subjects.name: Economics (0455)
subjects.description: Often the third commerce option. Diagram accuracy and causal reasoning rather than ledgers, which means it needs a different kind of hour. Families budgeting for two of the three should know that 0452 and 0455 share almost nothing in practice terms.

subjects.name: Mathematics (0580)
subjects.description: The hidden dependency. Ratio, percentage and fraction fluency sit under most of 0452's marks, and a student losing accounting marks to arithmetic is paying accounting rates for a maths problem. Two 0580 sessions are often cheaper than four 0452 sessions treating the symptom.

subjects.name: Additional Mathematics (0606)
subjects.description: Taken by stronger Dubai cohorts, frequently in the slot a second commerce subject would use. Mentioned for budget reasons: a student carrying 0606 and 0452 is carrying two subjects that both demand regular written practice, and the weekly time budget usually breaks before the money does.

subjects.name: First Language English (0500)
subjects.description: Relevant to one part of 0452 only, and it is the expensive part. Ratio interpretation and comments on financial performance are written answers, and students who write thin prose in English write thin interpretation in Accounting. The skill transfers in both directions.

subjects.name: English as a Second Language (0510 and 0511)
subjects.description: Many Dubai candidates sit ESL. In 0452 the cost shows in terminology precision: a student who confuses provision with reserve, or drawings with expenses, loses marks that have nothing to do with their understanding of the procedure.

subjects.name: Information and Communication Technology (0417)
subjects.description: A common fourth option in Dubai commerce-leaning blocks. Needs machine time rather than tutor time, which is useful to know when splitting a fixed monthly budget: the practical papers reward solo practice more cheaply than 0452's structured papers do.

subjects.name: Geography (0460)
subjects.description: Frequently the subject 0452 competes with on a Year 9 option form. Three papers against two and a skills component, so the two-year tutoring profile is more spread out. Worth comparing before the option block closes rather than after.

subjects.name: Enterprise (0454)
subjects.description: Offered by a small number of Dubai centres as a project-assessed alternative within the commerce group. Not interchangeable with 0452 for sixth-form entry, so confirm with the school before treating a grade in one as satisfying a condition quoted for the other.

sections.heading: What 0452 support costs in Dubai, costed by topic area
paragraphs: Pricing Accounting by the hour hides the thing a parent needs to know, which is how many hours. Because the syllabus is sequential and procedural, the hours are estimable in a way they are not for an essay subject. The table below takes the seven topic areas of Cambridge 0452, estimates the tutoring time each typically needs for a student who is behind in it, and says whether a budget-tier tutor can do the job.

The estimates assume a student who has been taught the material once in school and has not retained it, which is the usual situation rather than a student meeting it for the first time. They also assume marked written practice between sessions, because in Accounting the practice is where the learning happens and the session is where the errors get named. A plan with no written practice between sessions needs roughly twice the hours to reach the same accuracy.

Multiply the hours by a band and you have a budget. Six hours on financial statements at the specialist band is AED 1,200 to 2,700; the same six hours at the qualified-tutor band is AED 900 to 1,800. Whether the difference is worth paying depends entirely on which area you are buying, and that is the argument the final column is making. For the first two areas the answer is usually no. For the last three it is usually yes.

One context figure worth holding alongside the tutoring numbers: KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under the emirate's second economic incentives package. Exam entry is separate again, paid to the centre entering your child, with deadlines months ahead of the papers.

sections.heading: Accounting is procedural, so what you are buying is marked volume
paragraphs: In a discursive subject the expensive part of tutoring is judgement: somebody reading an argument and saying why it fell short. In Accounting the expensive part is volume with correction. A student does not learn to prepare a statement of financial position by watching it done; they learn by doing twenty and having the errors named each time. That changes what a sensible purchase looks like.

The practical consequence is that the session is not the product. The product is the cycle: the student works a set of questions alone, somebody marks them with the error located rather than just circled, and the next set is chosen to attack that error. A tutor who fills sixty minutes with worked examples on a screen is selling the cheapest half of the service and withholding the expensive half, which is the marking.

This is why the marking question is the single most important thing to ask about a Dubai quote for 0452. Some rates include a marked structured component between sessions; others bill marking at the same hourly rate, which can add a third to a monthly total. For an essay subject that distinction affects quality. For Accounting it affects whether the tutoring works at all, because without marked volume the student simply repeats the same ledger error with more confidence.

The upside of a procedural subject is that it is cheap to measure. An error count per paper is a number a parent can read: six transposition errors and two format errors in week one, two and none in week five. No interpretation is required, no grade estimate is needed, and nobody has to take a tutor's word for whether the sessions are working.

sections.heading: Where a cheaper 0452 tutor stops being cheaper
paragraphs: Four parts of the syllabus reliably defeat a tutor who knows accounting but has not worked through Cambridge 0452 scripts. The first is the financial statements of partnerships and limited companies. A competent accountant will produce a technically correct statement in the layout they use professionally, and 0452 credits a specific presentation. Correct figures in the wrong format lose marks, and the student has no way of knowing which version to trust.

The second is manufacturing accounts, which are a schoolroom construct rather than a thing practising accountants prepare, so professional experience is no help and syllabus familiarity is everything. The third is incomplete records, where the task is to reconstruct missing figures from fragments; it is the area that separates grade bands most sharply and the one where unguided practice goes wrong silently, because a student can produce a plausible answer that is wrong throughout.

The fourth is analysis and interpretation. Ratio calculation is arithmetic and anyone can teach it. The marks sit in the comment: what this ratio suggests about this business, compared with the previous year or with another firm. That is a written skill, and the mark scheme credits specific kinds of statement. A tutor who has not read mark schemes will accept answers that a marker would not, and the student will discover this in June.

A sensible Dubai budget therefore splits by area rather than buying one rate for everything. Cheap hours for the fundamentals, recording, verification and principles. Specialist hours for statements, incomplete records, interpretation and whole-paper timing. A family that does this spends less in total than one that pays a mid-band rate across all seven areas, and gets a better result in the four that decide the grade.

sections.heading: The 0452 components, and the cheapest route to each kind of mark
paragraphs: Cambridge has revised 0452, and which version your child sits changes the practice plan. The current syllabus pairs a shorter objective-question paper with a longer structured written paper; earlier cohorts sat two equally weighted structured written papers. The format, durations and weightings for your child's series are published in the syllabus document on cambridgeinternational.org, and the exams officer at the school knows which version the centre has entered. Confirm it before planning, because the two versions reward different spending.

The reason it matters financially is that objective questions are nearly free to practise. A student can work through them alone, check answers against a key, and self-correct without anybody marking anything. Structured written questions are the opposite: they are where format, presentation and the carried-forward error live, and they cannot be usefully self-marked by a student who does not yet know the conventions.

So the cost-efficient plan on the current syllabus is to push objective practice almost entirely into independent work and spend the paid hours on structured written questions. Families routinely do the reverse, because objective practice is easy to supervise and feels productive. The table makes the distinction explicit, with the cheapest adequate route to each kind of mark in the final column.

One caution on all of the above. We reference the Cambridge syllabus and link the official page; we do not reproduce or distribute syllabus documents, past papers or mark schemes. Any provider advertising a download library of Cambridge material is distributing work it does not own, which is a reasonable prompt to check its other claims.

sections.heading: In-home 0452 tuition in Dubai, priced against online
paragraphs: IB Gram does not sell in-home visits in the UAE, and home visits are a service we run only in India. The comparison still belongs on this page, because a Dubai family searching for an Accounting tutor is choosing between formats as much as between providers, and the subject has a specific quirk that makes the comparison less obvious than usual.

The quirk is that Accounting works better on a shared screen than most subjects work on any screen. Ledger work is spatial: the error is in a particular cell of a particular statement, and pointing at it precisely matters more than eye contact. On a shared screen both people see the same cursor in the same cell. Across a kitchen table, the tutor sees the page upside down, which is a small thing that compounds over ninety minutes of correction.

Against that, an in-home tutor can confiscate a phone and keep a fourteen-year-old working for two hours, and no amount of screen quality replicates that. For a Year 10 student with an attention problem rather than an accounting problem, the in-home market rate of AED 180 to 500 an hour may be buying supervision, and supervision is a legitimate thing to buy. It is simply not the same purchase as subject depth.

The scheduling economics also favour online in this subject specifically. 0452 rewards short, frequent contact: fifteen minutes to fix one reconciliation error on Tuesday, ninety minutes for a full structured paper on Saturday. No tutor can price a fifteen-minute visit across Dubai in evening traffic, so in-home arrangements default to one long weekly session, which is the shape the subject least needs.

sections.heading: Resits, series choice and the money that is not tutoring
paragraphs: Cambridge runs IGCSE in a June series and a November series, and Dubai candidates almost always sit June with November used for resits. Entry is made by the centre, not the family, and the deadline sits a long way ahead of the paper. The March 2027 series is a useful illustration of the gap even though it is used in a limited set of territories: Cambridge gives the exam period as 3 February to 4 March 2027, with final entries due 27 November 2026, forecast grades due 27 February 2027, results on Direct 13 May and certificates in late June.

The financial lesson is about sequence rather than amount. A family deciding in February whether to fund a resit block is deciding after the entry window for the nearest series has closed. Any resit plan has to be made with the exams officer months earlier, and a tutoring budget built around a resit that was never entered is money with nowhere to go.

For Dubai centres using Pearson Edexcel instead, International GCSE exams are available in May or June and in November, with provisional timetables published ahead of each series. The November 2026 final timetable runs from late October to 19 November 2026. June 2026 results went to centres on 19 August 2026 and to students on 20 August 2026, and November 2025 results reached students on 22 January 2026. Work from the live official timetable rather than any restated date, including these, because provisional versions are revised.

A resit in Accounting is unusually likely to be worth funding, for a structural reason. The subject is procedural, so a student who scored poorly because two topic areas were never secured can be made secure in those two areas over a summer, and the paper does not change its demands between series. That is a very different proposition from resitting an essay subject, where the improvement is slower and less certain.

sections.heading: Is the tutor you are paying legally permitted to teach in the UAE?
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is permitted, not unregulated, and the detail is worth knowing before money changes hands. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is issued through MoHRE. It is granted free of charge for two years, and MoHRE's own service page, 'Issuance of a New Work Permit - Private Tutor Licensing', lists a two-working-day completion time via the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system.

The eligibility list is broader than parents expect: teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. That last category explains a chunk of the AED 45 to 65 end of the Dubai market. A sixteen-year-old with a permit tutoring a Year 9 student is operating entirely within the rules, and may be excellent, and is not the person to hire for incomplete records.

There is a conflict-of-interest rule that matters in Abu Dhabi and is worth knowing emirate-wide. ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit teachers from providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit's code of conduct also bars serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. This is press-reported and worth verifying against the current policy document, but the direction is clear: 'your child's own teacher, privately' is not a product anyone should be selling.

Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published, so any specific amount circulating online is unverified and we will not repeat one. On the other side, a tutoring business with premises and staff in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, with annual renewal requested at least thirty days before expiry. IB Gram holds no such permit and does not need one, because it operates no premises in the UAE, and we do not describe our tutors as approved by any regulator.

sections.heading: How 0452 sessions run, and what we will not claim
paragraphs: A family sends a marked Accounting paper, or names the topic areas the school has flagged. The trial lesson is free and collects no card details, and it is spent working through that paper rather than on a sales conversation. It ends with a written note listing the topic areas that need work, the estimated hours for each, and which of them a cheaper tutor could cover. That last column is in the note even though it costs us bookings.

Sessions then run one-to-one over live video at a fixed slot in Gulf Standard Time, with ledger work on a shared screen so both people are looking at the same cell. Written practice is set between sessions, marked with the error located rather than circled, and returned before the next session. Progress is reported as an error count per paper, because that is the honest measure in a procedural subject.

On availability, the honest version. 0452 is sat by a smaller cohort than maths or the sciences, and specialists in the harder areas are not always free at the evening hours Dubai families want. When that is the case we say so, offer the nearest match with the limitation stated, and give the likely wait for the specialist. A Year 11 student who needs incomplete records marked properly is badly served by a generalist, however pleasant the hour.

Two fixed boundaries. A tutor teaches, reviews and gives feedback on work the student has produced, and nobody here will produce assessed material for a student under any board. And we reference Cambridge material rather than distributing it, working from the copies your child's school has issued. No page of ours claims accreditation from KHDA, ADEK, MoE, Cambridge or Pearson, because IB Gram holds none, and no page of ours promises a grade.

process.title: Send a marked paper or the flagged topic areas
process.description: A photograph of a marked 0452 attempt with the school's annotations is the fastest possible start. Failing that, the list of topic areas the school has raised is enough. Either way, naming the areas rather than the subject gets a costed answer in hours instead of a week of diagnostic questions.

process.title: Free trial lesson, spent on the paper
process.description: One session at no cost and with no card details collected, worked through your child's own attempt. You end with a written note: the topic areas that need work, estimated hours for each, and which of them a cheaper tutor could cover adequately. That note is useful whoever you end up booking.

process.title: Buy a block, not a subscription
process.description: For a procedural subject a finite block aimed at named topic areas is the better purchase. The total is known upfront, the target is an accuracy measure rather than a date, and the block ends when the procedure holds under timing rather than when a term finishes.

process.title: Practise alone, get it marked
process.description: The student works a set of questions between sessions without help, and the marking locates each error rather than circling the answer. The session is spent on the errors and on a second attempt at the same question type, because in Accounting the repeat attempt is where the procedure sticks.

process.title: Track the error count and stop when it flattens
process.description: Progress is reported as errors per paper, split into transposition, direction and format. When the count stops falling the block has done its work, and continuing out of habit is the commonest way Dubai families overspend on this subject. We will say when that point has arrived.

whyPoints.title: The hours are costed, not just the rate
whyPoints.description: Seven topic areas with estimated hours and an AED range for each, so a parent can build a budget before speaking to anybody. Most tutoring pages publish no price at all; three of six researched competitors publish none, and the two that do quote in US dollars.

whyPoints.description: Four of the seven 0452 areas can be covered adequately at a budget rate with marked practice. That is in the table and in the trial-lesson note. It costs us hours and it is the honest answer for a family deciding how to split a fixed budget across two subjects.

whyPoints.title: Marking is the product, and it is specified
whyPoints.description: Written practice marked with the error located rather than circled, returned before the next session. In a procedural subject this is the part that moves marks, and it is the part most commonly billed separately or quietly omitted from a quote.

whyPoints.description: Progress is reported as errors per paper by type: transposition, direction, format. A parent can read it without knowing the syllabus, and it cannot be dressed up. No tutor can promise a grade in 0452, and we do not report numbers that imply one.

whyPoints.description: Financial statements, manufacturing accounts, incomplete records and interpretation need somebody who has worked through Cambridge scripts. Over live video that person does not need to live near Mirdif, Mudon or Al Qusais, which is where local specialist supply is thinnest.

faqs.question: What does a Cambridge IGCSE Accounting 0452 tutor cost per hour in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Market rates put a qualified online subject tutor at roughly AED 150 to 300 an hour and an exam-board specialist at AED 200 to 450, with Unitors publishing IGCSE tuition from AED 150, TutorChase quoting AED 270 and Bestimate's 2026 Dubai table reaching AED 450 and above. In-home one-to-one is quoted from AED 180 to 500 with travel absorbed. These are published market figures from the providers named rather than an IB Gram price list, and the more useful question in this subject is how many hours each topic area needs.

faqs.question: How many hours of 0452 tutoring does a Dubai student actually need?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on which topic areas are weak, and that is knowable from one marked paper. Rough estimates for a student who was taught the material and did not retain it: one to two hours on fundamentals, three to five on recording and on verification, four to six on accounting procedures, five to eight on financial statements, three to five on interpretation, and two to three on whole-paper timing. A student with two weak areas needs eight to twelve hours. A student weak across the syllabus needs a weekly slot through Year 11.

faqs.question: Can a cheaper tutor teach Accounting adequately, or is that a false economy?
faqs.answer: In this subject, partly adequate. Four of the seven 0452 areas are procedural enough that a competent graduate with marked practice can cover them: fundamentals, recording of data, verification, and principles and policies. Four areas defeat a non-specialist with some reliability: financial statements, where format decides marks; manufacturing accounts; incomplete records; and ratio interpretation, where the wording of a comment earns the credit. The economical plan buys cheap hours for the first group and specialist hours for the second.

faqs.question: Why does my child lose marks on statements that contain the right figures?
faqs.answer: Because 0452 credits presentation as well as arithmetic. A statement of financial position or an income statement has a required structure, and an answer with correct totals in a professional layout the syllabus does not use will lose marks a student cannot see. This is the commonest reason a tutor with real accounting experience but no Cambridge experience underperforms: the layout they use at work is right in the office and wrong in the exam, and the student has no way to tell which to trust.

faqs.question: Is marking included in a Dubai tutor's hourly rate for Accounting?
faqs.answer: Ask, because it varies and it decides whether the tutoring works. At the budget end the advertised rate is usually teaching time only, with marking billed at the same hourly rate, which can add a third to a monthly total. At the specialist end marked written practice is normally inside the rate. In a procedural subject the marking is not an optional extra; without it a student repeats the same ledger error with increasing confidence, so a cheap rate with no marking is the most expensive option available.

faqs.question: Does the Cambridge 0452 syllabus still have two written papers of equal weight?
faqs.answer: Check the syllabus document for your child's series, because Cambridge revised the subject. The current version pairs a shorter objective-question paper with a longer structured written paper, where earlier cohorts sat two equally weighted structured written papers. Your school's exams officer knows which version the centre has entered. It matters financially: objective questions can be practised alone against an answer key at no cost, while structured written questions need marking, so the paid hours should go to the second.

faqs.question: Which 0452 topic area is worth spending the most on?
faqs.answer: Preparation of financial statements, usually five to eight hours for a student who is behind, because it carries a large share of the structured paper and because errors there are invisible to the student. Incomplete records is the next priority, for a different reason: it is where grade bands separate most sharply and where unguided practice fails silently, since a reconstruction can look entirely plausible and be wrong from the second line onwards. Interpretation is third and the cheapest of the three to fix.

faqs.question: Will IB Gram arrange an Accounting tutor to come to our Dubai home?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer in-home visits anywhere in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India. Dubai families are taught one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time, with ledger work on a shared screen. For Accounting that suits the subject: the error is in a specific cell of a specific statement, and on a shared screen both people are looking at the same cursor rather than at a notebook viewed from the wrong angle.

faqs.question: Is it cheaper to take Accounting and Business Studies with one tutor?
faqs.answer: The hourly rate rarely changes, but the total hours do. Working capital, sources of finance and ratio analysis appear in both 0452 and 0450, so a tutor who sees both sets of marked work teaches a shared idea once and applies it twice. Expect to save roughly two to three hours across a year rather than half the bill. The caution is that the subjects fail differently, so a tutor strong in one is not automatically useful in the other; ask about both separately.

faqs.question: Is a resit in Accounting worth paying for after a poor June result?
faqs.answer: More often than in most subjects, for a structural reason. Accounting is procedural, so a student who scored poorly because two topic areas were never secured can be made secure in those areas over a summer, and the paper's demands do not change between series. That is a very different proposition from resitting an essay subject. The constraint is administrative: entry is made by the centre and the deadline sits months before the paper, so the decision has to be taken with the exams officer early.

faqs.question: Can my child practise 0452 questions without a tutor marking them?
faqs.answer: Objective questions yes, against an answer key, and that practice should be free and independent. Structured written questions no, with one exception. A student who already knows the required format can self-check figures, but a student learning the format cannot, because the whole problem is not knowing which presentation earns the marks. Incomplete records is the clearest case: a reconstruction can be internally consistent, plausible and wrong throughout, and only somebody who knows the method will spot where it diverged.

faqs.question: Does a tutor in Dubai need a permit, and does it cost us anything?
faqs.answer: A permit is required and it costs nothing. The private tuition work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is issued through MoHRE, and is granted free of charge for two years, with MoHRE listing a two-working-day completion time on its own service page. So any tutor describing the permit as a cost to be passed on is describing something that does not exist. Those tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no official fine schedule is published.

faqs.question: Why are some Dubai Accounting tutors advertising AED 45 an hour?
faqs.answer: Partly because the MoHRE permit eligibility list includes university students and school students aged 15 to 18, so the low end of the market is legitimate rather than irregular. EdFlik advertises from AED 45 to 65 and Tutopiya from AED 33 to 52. A well-organised student tutor can genuinely drill double entry and control accounts. What they cannot usually do is mark a limited company's financial statements against the required format or judge whether an interpretation comment earns the credit.

faqs.question: How should we split a fixed monthly budget between Accounting and a second subject?
faqs.answer: Diagnose both first, then spend by area rather than by subject. Accounting hours are estimable because the syllabus is sequential, so you can put a number on what it needs; a discursive subject usually cannot be costed that precisely. The common mistake is an even split, which overfunds the subject that happens to be worrying you this month. A single trial lesson in each produces two written estimates, and the split follows from those rather than from anxiety.

faqs.question: What does progress in 0452 look like if not a rising mock grade?
faqs.answer: An error count per paper, split by type. Transposition errors, direction errors where a debit and credit are reversed, and format errors where the figures are right and the presentation is not. Six, three and two in week one becoming two, zero and zero by week five is real movement, and a parent can read it without knowing the syllabus. Mock grades in Dubai are set internally against the school's own boundary estimate, so they are a rough position rather than a measurement.
